law: Rotary is linear in x: rope(a·x) = a·rope(x) for a pair-constant factor — a scalar or per-row broadcast rides outside the whole elementwise chain.
name: rope_cat_scale_out

law: Reverse: push a uniform factor inside the rotary so the view/weight laws can route it into a projection.
name: rope_cat_scale_in

law: x·cos + rotate_half(x)·sin is also x-linear: a uniform factor rides out of the HF spelling.
name: rope_rh_scale_out

law: Reverse: push a uniform factor inside the rotate-half spelling.
name: rope_rh_scale_in

law: (xWᵀ)R = x(RᵀW)ᵀ — a constant right-multiply absorbs into the projection weight (rotary-by-matmul included).
name: linear_mm_absorb

law: Reverse absorb — eqsat weighs the folded weight against a runtime right-multiply.
name: linear_mm_absorb_rev

law: Affine right-multiply absorb: (xWᵀ + b)R = x(RᵀW)ᵀ + bR — the fused bias is the matvec b@R, both products compile-time.
name: linear_mm_absorb_bias

law: Reverse biased absorb (eqsat weighs fused vs split).
name: linear_mm_absorb_bias_rev

law: Row-uniform scale slides out of a matmul's left operand: (s·A)@B = s·(A@B) — the left mirror of naturality_scalar.
name: naturality_scalar_left

law: Reverse: s·(A@B) = (s·A)@B — pushes a score scale into the left factor, where the view/weight laws route it to Wq.
name: naturality_scalar_left_rev

law: Uniform scale folds into the weight: s·(xWᵀ) = x(sW)ᵀ — the runtime mul becomes a compile-time weight mul.
name: linear_out_scale

law: Reverse uniform fold — eqsat compares weight-folded vs runtime-scaled forms.
name: linear_out_scale_rev
